name: tgo-id
description: TGO ID — root runner that installs, builds, and runs the identity server (:4000) and the account web app (:5173) together.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix web run preview"
